findingDetails.title: The isolation lever reaches one of the two suite configs
findingDetails.scopeProof: The two configs are the only advisor suite entry points; rg -n "TMPDIR|mkdtemp" runtime/vitest*.config.ts returns the block in vitest.config.ts and nothing in vitest.stress.config.ts.
findingDetails.case: An operator runs npm run test:stress -- --config vitest.stress.config.ts; os.tmpdir() stays the system folder, so any durable record the suite writes lands in the shared metrics folder beside the real ones.

results.summary: REQ-001/AC-001 and T053 read against the changed lines; both name the mechanism the code carries.
T002, AC-001, AC-005, T053 and T043 each record observed evidence; the one gap is a summary sentence, not a checklist row.
the playbook inspects the metrics folder after a manual hook run, which no suite config changes.
